title: Simulation 3D Ultrasonic Sensor
text: Ultrasonic sensor model in 3D simulation environment, 6 outputs, {Mounting location} sets Sensor mounting location; {Sensor identifier} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Parent name} sets the name of parent vehicle, {Specify offset} sets the offset from mounting location, {Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the translation offset relative to mounting location, {Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the rotational offset relative to mounting location, {Sample time}, {Detection ranges (m)} sets the detection range vector of ultrasonic, {Horizontal field of view (deg)} sets the horizontal field of view of ultrasonic, {Vertical field of view (deg)} sets the vertical field of view of ultrasonic, {Use bus output} sets the output signals together as bus and {Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} sets the output location and orientation of sensor. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Has object
ports.summary: Detectable object present in sensor field-of-view scalar

ports.name: Has range
ports.summary: Range measurement possible for object present in sensor field-of-view scalar

ports.name: Range
ports.summary: Distance measurement to closest object scalar

params.name: Parent name
params.values: Name of parent vehicle Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: Sensor mounting location Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: Specify offset from mounting location off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: Translation offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: Rotational offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Detection ranges (m)
params.values: Detection range vector of ultrasonic sensor (m) [0.03 0.15 5.5] (default) | 1-by-3 nonnegative real-valued vector of form [minDetOnlyRange minDistRange maxDistRange]

params.name: Horizontal field of view (deg)
params.values: Horizontal field of view of ultrasonic sensor 70 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Vertical field of view (deg)
params.values: Vertical field of view of ultrasonic sensor 35 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Use bus output
params.values: Output signals together as bus on (default) | off

params.name: Output location (m) and orientation (rad)
params.values: Output location and orientation of sensor off (default) | on
